hero.headline: Built by people who hate broken processes
hero.subheadline: Task2Flow started in a 3-person startup where every project lived in a different Slack thread. We built the tool we wished existed.

mission.headline: Our mission
mission.body: We believe every team — from a two-person startup to a 500-person org — deserves workflows that actually work. Not rigid templates. Not another project management tool. Just a clear, repeatable path from idea to done.

values.title: Speed over ceremony
values.description: Get to running workflows in minutes, not weeks. No onboarding calls required.

values.title: AI that earns its place
values.description: We use AI where it genuinely saves time — parsing tasks, suggesting steps — not as a buzzword.

values.title: Teams first
values.description: Every feature is designed for how real teams work: async, distributed, and always context-switching.

team.name: Leila Nasser

team.name: Ravi Mehta

cta.headline: Want to shape the product?
cta.body: We're talking to early users every week. If you want to influence what we build next, get on the waitlist and tell us what you need.
